scope: CanonCommit acceptance revalidates committed MutationPlan target bytes before edition freeze

redEvidence.test: rejects a committed canon plan whose target bytes have drifted
redEvidence.beforeFix: A committed plan remained acceptable even when a declared target byte hash no longer matched the working tree.

greenEvidence.command: npm.cmd --prefix api run test -- src/editionManifest.spec.ts src/contractCanonAdoption.spec.ts --reporter=dot

boundary: Target freshness is checked before creating a new edition; already frozen historical editions remain immutable and downstream settlement/closure/delivery gates still apply.
